تستعلموا (form X)
# تَسْتَعْلِمُوا (tastaʕlimū) /tas.taʕ.li.muː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعْلَمَ (istaʕlama)
# تُسْتَعْلَمُوا (tustaʕlamū) /tus.taʕ.la.muː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعْلَمَ (istaʕlama)
